text:
Jordan: Quick sync — need final defs for the reliability dashboard we're handing to Console + Alerts. Focus: timeouts, 5xx, OOM kills, degraded-mode entries, and fallback counts. Runtime + infra inputs + rollout UX concerns. Who's available?

Ashley: I can take the Console/UX side. We need dimensions so customers can slice by route, model, and deployment (canary vs active).

Mike: From runtime: we can instrument everything but we need a single canonical metric per failure class. Multiple services currently emit `request_timeout` and `rpc_timeout` separately. We should agree on names and labels.

Sophia: Obs side: prefer counter metrics with labels, avoid gauge toggles. Suggested canonical names (draft):
```
runtime_request_timeout_total{route,model,region,deploy_type} 
runtime_5xx_total{route,model,region,service,deploy_type} 
runtime_oom_killed_total{host,gpu_type,model,region} 
runtime_degraded_mode_entries_total{route,model,region,reason}  allbacks_count_total{route,model,region,fallback_tier,reason}
```
Pros: simple for PromQL panels + alerting.

Andre: Important: dedupe across path hops. If a request goes through router -> planner -> runtime and each emits a 5xx, we must choose a counting owner. Proposal: only the runtime that ultimately returns the 5xx increments `runtime_5xx_total`. Router should emit `router_reject_total` for pre-routing rejects.

Kevin: For rollouts UX, Console wants `deploy_type` label with values `canary`, `stable`, `fallback-policy` so product teams can compare. Also need `canary_percent` as a numeric label? that's harder in Prometheus. Maybe record it in the Dashboard context header instead of label.

Jordan: Good call. Also we need a standard `fallback_reason` enum for fallback counts: `capacity`, `latency_slo`, `model_error`, `auth` — so dashboards can aggregate by cause.

Mike: Implementation constraints: adding many labels hurts cardinality. We should make `model` optional or only for per-model dashboards. Default telemetry should include `route`, `region`, `deploy_type`, and `reason` for fallback metrics. `service` label for 5xx is useful for cross-service debugging.

Ashley: Console wants an example panel layout: top row — 5xx rate (global + by region), timeouts (p95 p99), OOMs (count + per-host), degraded-mode entries trend, fallbacks by tier and reason. Drilldowns to per-route and per-deploy.

Sophia: Alerting proposals:
- 5xx rate > 1% for 5m aggregated by `route` => Sev3
- runtime_request_timeout_total spike >= 50/min for 3m => Sev2
- OOMs >= 3 hosts in 10m => Sev2
- fallback rate > baseline * 5 (baseline = rolling 24h median) => Sev2

Andre: We also need runbook tags: alert should include `owner_service` label so oncall knows who to ping. Runtime can attach `owner_service` during emit.

Kevin: UX: Console will show both raw counts and normalized rates (per-1000 requests). Need `requests_total{route,region}` metric as well for normalization.

Mike: About degraded mode counting: we expose `degraded_mode_entries_total` whenever we drop functionality and route to a degraded path. Important to include `degraded_type` label (e.g., `kv_cache_miss`, `quantized_model`, `fallback_model`) so product can see why. But again: cardinality tradeoff.

Jordan: Decision proposals (vote):
1) Adopt the Sophia canonical names.
2) Default labels: `route`, `region`, `deploy_type`, plus `reason`/`degraded_type`/`fallback_tier` where relevant. `model` optional (emit under a separate metric family if needed).
3) Owner: runtime team owns `runtime_5xx_total` and `runtime_request_timeout_total` counts; router owns `router_reject_total`; console team owns dashboard UX.

Ashley: +1 to names. We'll design UX around those labels. For `model` per-route drilldown, Console will query the `model`-annotated metric family (separate panel) to avoid wide cardinality by default.

Mike: +1 from runtime. We'll implement counts and add `owner_service`. For OOMs, we'll emit `oom_kill` events to both metrics and logging to capture host/GPU info.

Sophia: I'll draft PromQL snippets for panels and share in a follow-up thread. For example 5xx rate panel: `sum(rate(runtime_5xx_total[5m])) by (route) / sum(rate(requests_total[5m])) by (route)`

Andre: On dedupe: runtime will only count final errors. If intermediate services drop request, they must emit a distinct metric name (e.g., `service_drop_total`) and set `drop_reason`. That keeps sums meaningful.

Jordan: Action items:
- Mike: implement canonical metrics + `owner_service` label in runtime (ETA: 2 sprints).
- Sophia: write PromQL panel templates and alert rules (ETA: 3 days).
- Ashley: mock Console panels and drilldown flows (ETA: 1 week).
- Andre: update runbooks with new alert names/owners (ETA: 1 week).
- Kevin: confirm rollout label enum values with PMs (ETA: 2 days).

Kevin: Will do. Also note we should include an internal note on expected cardinality and retention to finance for cost impact if we add `model` by default.

deploy-bot: Deployment queued: runtime/telemetry v2 (includes metric name changes) — scheduled for 2026-04-02 03:00 UTC. :rocket:

Jordan: Thanks all — want a quick follow-up sync Wed 10am to sign off. If anyone has objections to the decision proposals above, please flag them here before EOD tomorrow.
